title: TWIHN independent public story tags v1
$comment: Runtime validation via scripts/tags.mjs validateStoryRecord is also required: all tag references exist in the validated registry, tagSlugs are in ascending slug order and issueIds in ascending date order. Validators reject noncanonical ordering rather than mutate input. Archive-level validation separately checks actual published issue identity and exact membership. HN IDs are literal strings, never trimmed or coerced.
